name: Pit Room
description: A wide pit splits the chamber floor. The far side is reachable—but the stone looks slick, and the drop disappears into shadow.

skill_check.fall_text: You slip on the slick stone and plunge into the pit!

interactables.name: pit edge
interactables.examine_text: A slick, treacherous jump. You could try to cross it—or you could fall.
